hypotheses.P1_quadratic64_is_predictive: At router dimension 64, exact selected modes reach median full-score correlation at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_quadratic64_beats_cluster64: At router dimension 64, exact routed correlation exceeds the prior 64-cluster router by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P3_quadratic128_approaches_oracle: At router dimension 128, exact routed correlation is within 0.05 of oracle adaptive selection on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_quadratic64_recovers_support: At router dimension 64, predicted top-16 support recall is at least 0.40 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P5_quadratic64_is_executable: At router dimension 64, summing the reduced-context predicted contributions of selected modes reaches correlation at least 0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P6_router_improves_monotonically: On every corpus, exact routed correlation is nondecreasing across router dimensions 16, 32, 64, and 128.
